name: Euro-area economy
summary: Euro-area October composite PMI near 52 and Q3 GDP +0.4%, both above Normal lines; Sentix morale dipped on 9 Nov
state: S&P Global's flash euro-area composite PMI was 51.9 in October, down from 53.1 and a four-month low, consistent with GDP growth of about 0.3% a quarter; France's output contracted (S&P Global, 23 Oct). Q3 GDP rose 0.4% on the preliminary estimate, with the next estimate due on 13 Nov. The Sentix investor index slipped to 2.4 in November from 2.7 (9 Nov). Growth is slowing but remains above the Watch lines.
for_you: A slowing euro-area economy affects UK exporters, since the EU is the UK's largest trading partner. Current data show growth continuing at a slower pace.

sources.title: S&P Global — HCOB Flash Eurozone Composite PMI, October 2026
ActionForex — Eurozone Sentix falls to 2.4 as recovery expectations weaken

why: The euro area is the UK's largest trading partner; stagnation there hits UK exports and European markets.
drivers: Energy prices, German industry, ECB policy, fiscal rules, China demand.

rubric.alert: Technical recession, or PMI < 45, or bond-spread fragmentation forcing ECB action.
rubric.normal: Positive GDP growth and composite PMI > 50.
